active_palace_authority: GEN-37 original front elevation; GEN-03 and GEN-16 supporting views
notes: All saved image files from generated_images and shared are preserved by content hash.
Byte-identical duplicates share one file; source_aliases retain every original path.
Additional generated studies include superseded palace experiments and unapproved variants.
Previews, crops, vectors and renders do not count as newly completed illustrated asset sheets.
Registered render pairs share model geometry, but the native model is not certified as an exact match to the reference art.
Every image has a stable ID and versioned content hash; component IDs link named model targets to an exact reference hash. IDs are not approval or completion claims.
PACK-BRG-001 contains 16 named ornaments; PACK-BRG-002 contains four named bridge segments. MOD sheets are retained single-component development studies, superseded by the user-requested pack format.
PACK-BRG-001 revision 2 corrects A03 to the supplied stepped capital. Original revision is preserved as PACK-BRG-001-R01. Model provenance must include the reference hash or revision.

Original bridge panels A–G and overview views are preserved as ten named exact pixel crops. Source comparison flags discrepancies in the generated bridge packs; do not claim exact GEN-18 reconstruction readiness.
